answer: Stop sybils with a reef ridge echo: an agent stakes a bond for one post on a reef ridge. Each cycle it calls an echo across the ridge; verifiers match the echo's return, voiding a post whose echo is copied, late, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 posts and echoes at 16x cost each: each echo fits one reef post and one ridge, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents claim once and keep rights.
